+Parser:
+  Title: DNS activity ASIM parser for Halcyon
+  Version: '0.1.0'
+  LastUpdated: Jun 09, 2026
+Product:
+  Name: Halcyon
+Normalization:
+  Schema: Dns
+  Version: '0.1.7'
+References:
+- Title: ASIM DNS Schema
+  Link: https://aka.ms/ASimDnsDoc
+- Title: ASIM
+  Link: https://aka.ms/AboutASIM
+- Title: Halcyon Documentation
+  Link: https://www.halcyon.ai
+Description: |
+  This ASIM parser supports normalizing Halcyon DNS activity events to the ASIM DNS normalized
+  schema. These events are generated by Halcyon's DNS-based threat detection and ingested into the
+  HalcyonEventsV2_CL table in Microsoft Sentinel.
+
+  Note: The HalcyonEventsV2_CL table must be configured on the Log Analytics workspace's Analytics plan to use this parser. The Basic Logs plan does not support invocation of user-defined functions, which is required for ASIM parser consumption.
+Exceptions:
+- Field: DvcFQDN
+  Warning: Empty value in optional field
+  Exception: DvcFQDN is derived when device.hostname is a fully-qualified domain name; when Halcyon emits a short hostname (no domain suffix), DvcFQDN is empty.
+- Field: DvcDomain
+  Warning: Empty value in recommended field
+  Exception: DvcDomain is derived when device.hostname is a fully-qualified domain name; when Halcyon emits a short hostname (no domain suffix), DvcDomain is empty.
+ParserName: ASimDnsHalcyon
+EquivalentBuiltInParser: _ASim_Dns_Halcyon
+ParserParams:
+  - Name: disabled
+    Type: bool
+    Default: false
+ParserQuery: |
+  let parser = (disabled:bool=false) {
+      // DNS query class name -> numeric class ID lookup (standard DNS CLASS values).
+      let DnsClassLookup = datatable(DnsQueryClassName:string, DnsQueryClass:int)
+      [
+          "IN", 1, "CH", 3, "HS", 4, "NONE", 254, "ANY", 255
+      ];
+      HalcyonEventsV2_CL
+      | where not(disabled)
+          and class_uid == 4003                                    // OCSF DnsActivity (constant for class 4003)
+      | extend DnsQueryClassName = coalesce(tostring(query.['class']), "IN")           // OCSF query.class (constant "IN")
+      | lookup kind=leftouter DnsClassLookup on DnsQueryClassName
+      | extend
+          EventType           = case(activity_id == 1, "Query", activity_id == 2, "Response", activity_id == 6, "Traffic", "Query"),
+          DnsQuery            = tostring(query.hostname),                              // OCSF query.hostname
+          DnsResponseCode     = toint(rcode_id),                                       // OCSF rcode_id (constant 0 = NoError; resolution succeeded)
+          DnsResponseCodeName = coalesce(tostring(rcode), tostring(_ASIM_LookupDnsResponseCode(toint(rcode_id)))),  // Halcyon emits rcode "NoError"; datatable fallback on rcode_id
+          DnsResponseName     = tostring(answers[0].rdata),
+          SrcUsername         = tostring(actor.user.name),
+          SrcUserId           = tostring(actor.user.uid),
+          SrcProcessName      = tostring(actor.process.file.name),
+          SrcProcessId        = tostring(actor.process.pid),
+          SrcProcessCommandLine = tostring(actor.process.cmd_line),
+          DvcHostname_raw     = tostring(device.hostname),
+          DvcId               = tostring(device.uid),
+          EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(severity)
+      | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
+      | extend
+          EventSubType    = case(activity_id == 1, "Request", activity_id == 2, "Response", "Request"),
+          // Security verdict drives EventResult/DvcAction, NOT rcode_id (always 0/NoError). Validated against Halcyon
+          // security verdict mapping: Block (action_id 2) => Failure/Block, Report (action_id 1) => Success/Allow.
+          EventResult     = case(action_id == 2, "Failure", action_id == 1, "Success", "NA"),
+          DvcAction       = case(action_id == 2, "Block", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
+          EventResultDetails = DnsResponseCodeName,
+          EventSeverity   = case(
+                                EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
+                                EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
+                                EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
+                                EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
+                                EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
+                                "Informational"),
+          EventStartTime  = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated),
+          Domain          = DnsQuery,
+          Dvc             = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname_raw),
+          DvcIdType       = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
+          SrcUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUsername), "Simple", ""),
+          SrcUserIdType   = case(
+                                isempty(SrcUserId), "",
+                                SrcUserId startswith "S-1-", "SID",
+                                "Other"),
+          // src_endpoint.hostname == device.hostname in Halcyon events, so source-side host fields mirror the resolved device fields.
+          SrcHostname     = DvcHostname,                                               // short hostname (ASIM Hostname type - no dots)
+          SrcFQDN         = DvcFQDN,                                                    // FQDN when device.hostname is fully-qualified, else empty
+          Src             = DvcHostname,                                               // Src alias for Hostname
+          Hostname        = DvcHostname,                                               // required alias
+          Process         = SrcProcessName,
+          User            = SrcUsername,
+          // All events in this class are security-flagged detections.
+          ThreatCategory  = "Malicious DNS",                                           // reasonable default given source semantics; validate with customers
+          ThreatOriginalRiskLevel = tostring(severity)
+      | extend
+          EventEndTime    = EventStartTime,
+          EventCount      = int(1),
+          EventUid        = HalcyonEventId,
+          EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
+          EventMessage    = tostring(message),
+          EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
+          EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
+          EventProduct    = "Halcyon",
+          EventVendor     = "Halcyon",
+          EventSchema     = "Dns",
+          EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.7",
+          AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
+                                "halcyon_dxp_rule",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_dxp_rule),
+                                "halcyon_alert_id",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
+                                "halcyon_tenant_id", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id)
+                            )
+      | project-away DvcHostname_raw

+status: Available

commented_code:
+id: d6ab015a-0a76-47f4-959f-54f49edff3f3
+name: AI Agents - Newly observed MCP server on existing agent
+description: |
+  Identifies MCP server names newly observed on an existing AI agent compared with its latest baseline snapshot. Review inventory and audit records to confirm whether the configuration change was authorized. Run within 2 days of a change to retain coverage.
+requiredDataConnectors: []
+tactics: []
+relevantTechniques: []
+query: |
+  let lookback = 14d;
+  let recent = 2d;
+  let IdentityIdtoUPN = materialize(
+      IdentityInfo
+      | extend ResolvedAccountUpn = tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", column_ifexists("AccountUPN", ""))),
+               IdentityTimestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", column_ifexists("TimeGenerated", datetime(null))))
+      | where isnotempty(AccountObjectId) and isnotempty(ResolvedAccountUpn)
+      | summarize arg_max(IdentityTimestamp, ResolvedAccountUpn) by AccountObjectId
+      | project AccountObjectId = tostring(AccountObjectId), AccountUpn = ResolvedAccountUpn);
+  let CurrentRaw = materialize(
+      AgentsInfo
+      | where Timestamp > ago(recent)
+      | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AgentId
+      | where LifecycleStatus != "Deleted");
+  let CurrentMcp =
+      CurrentRaw
+      | mv-expand Mcp = McpServers
+      | extend McpName = tostring(Mcp.name)
+      | where isnotempty(McpName)
+      | summarize CurrentMcpServers = make_set(McpName) by AgentId;
+  let BaselineRaw = materialize(
+      AgentsInfo
+      | where Timestamp between (ago(lookback) .. ago(recent))
+      | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AgentId);

```
grep -L 'DeviceVendor.*Ubiquiti' "Analytic Rules"/*.yaml "Hunting Queries"/*.yaml | ...
# (returns nothing — all 22 CSL-touching files are now UniFi-scoped)
```

- Analytic Rules: UnifiSyslogSshBruteForce, UnifiSyslogThreatIntelMatch, UnifiSyslogTorExitTraffic
- Hunting Queries: UnifiSyslogApplicationPortScanners, UnifiSyslogDhcpNakDecline, UnifiSyslogFirstSeenExternalSources, UnifiSyslogPortScannerSweep, UnifiSyslogSshTargetUsers, UnifiSyslogSudoActivityAudit, UnifiSyslogTiFeedEffectiveness, UnifiSyslogTopExternalAttackers, UnifiSyslogWifiDeauthFlood

+id: 99c9e2f5-9090-4da9-bf95-9c0d1e2f3a09
+name: "UniFi: DHCP NAK / DECLINE anomalies"
+description: |
+  Lists DHCP NAK (server denied) and DECLINE (client refused offer, usually IP conflict) bursts. Volume spikes can mean rogue DHCP, address-pool exhaustion, or a misconfigured client.
+requiredDataConnectors:
+  - connectorId: UnifiSyslogCCF
+    dataTypes:
+      - CommonSecurityLog
+tactics:
+  - Discovery
+  - Impact
+relevantTechniques:
+  - T1499
+query: |
+  CommonSecurityLog
+  | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
+  | where DeviceEventClassID in ("dhcp_NAK", "dhcp_DECLINE")
+  | summarize Events = count(),
+              Clients = make_set(SourceMACAddress, 25),
+              Hostnames = make_set(SourceHostName, 25),
+              Interfaces = make_set(DeviceInboundInterface, 5),
+              SampleClient = take_any(SourceMACAddress)
+    by DeviceAction
+  | order by Events desc
+entityMappings:
+  - entityType: Host
+    fieldMappings:
+      - identifier: HostName
+        columnName: SampleClient

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Fixed in c7adcd10be. Extended the `summarize` output with proper hostname + IP columns and rewrote `entityMappings` to use them:

```yaml
| summarize Events = count(),
            Clients = make_set(SourceMACAddress, 25),
            Hostnames = make_set(SourceHostName, 25),
            Interfaces = make_set(DeviceInboundInterface, 5),
            SampleHost = take_any(SourceHostName),
            SampleIP = take_any(SourceIP)
  by DeviceAction

entityMappings:
  - entityType: IP
    fieldMappings:
      - identifier: Address
        columnName: SampleIP
  - entityType: Host
    fieldMappings:
      - identifier: HostName
        columnName: SampleHost
```

Sentinel now resolves valid IP + Host entities instead of trying to resolve a Host from a MAC address string. Also picked up the vendor scope fix (`| where DeviceVendor =~ "Ubiquiti"`) at the top of the query in the same commit.
